title: Bannerstone – Lodestone Waypoints
description: Bannerstone upgrades your navigation by turning Lodestones into customizable, color-coded waypoints. Track your markers directly on vanilla maps and your locator bar. Navigate the world in style and never get lost again!
body:
# **✨ Bannerstone**

> **"A waypoint companion mod that lets you craft, customize, and track your own lodestone beacon waypoints."**

Bannerstone introduces a brand-new waypoint tracking system to Minecraft. Craft ethereal Bannerstone blocks, color-code them with vibrant banners, and watch as they register directly on your locator bar and vanilla maps—helping you navigate your world in style!

![Bannerstone Showcase](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_d01e62cc-e91e-419b-97c1-1c76bef82033.png)

---

## 🎯 **What does this mod do?**

Ever wanted a waypoint marker that integrates perfectly with vanilla maps? One that shows on your compass bar, lets you customize its name in an anvil, and fits the aesthetic of your base? **Bannerstone** makes it happen.

**Craft. Place. Track.**

---

## ✨ **Key Features**

| Icon | Feature Description                                                                          |
| :--: | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
|  📍  | **Customizable Waypoints:** Mark key locations with decorative block markers           |
|  🎨  | **16 Color Variations:** Fully integrated with all vanilla banner colors               |
| 🗺️ | **Vanilla Map Integration:** Displays live markers with custom name labels             |
|  🧭  | **Locator Bar HUD:** Seamless compass HUD integration tracking up to 1024 blocks       |
| 🏗️ | **Smart Placement:** Adaptive dual-mode placement (standing or wall-hanging)           |
| ⚒️ | **Anvil Compatible:** Rename waypoints before placing for personalized map tags        |
|  🧱  | **True Lodestone Physics:** Accurate hardness, sounds, and pickaxe mining requirements |

---

## 👻 **Meet the Bannerstones**

Place standing Bannerstones on the ground or hang them elegantly from walls. The custom renderer displays a beautiful colored banner matching your exact design.

![Bannerstone Variants](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_44d50e7e-1bf0-47d9-a0df-78ac73a675f4.png)

---

## 🔍 **Mechanics & Details**

### ⚒️ Crafting Recipe

The recipe requires a `Lodestone` at the center, a `Banner` of your choice on top, and `Glowstone Dust` framing the sides:

![Crafting Recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_f695caf5-f399-489d-ac75-155367730f9c.gif)

---

### 🗺️ Custom Map Markers & Anvil Names

Register your waypoints directly on your vanilla maps with custom descriptions:

- **Map Registration:** Right-click a placed Bannerstone with a vanilla `Map` to draw a marker.
- **Color Matching:** Map icons automatically match the hex color of the banner used.
- **Custom Naming:** Rename your Bannerstone in an `Anvil` before placing it; your custom name will display right next to the map marker!
- **Easy Toggle:** Right-click again with a map to seamlessly toggle the marker on or off.

---

### 🧭 Locator Bar & HUD Integration

Every placed Bannerstone automatically spawns a waypoint beacon:

- **Long-Range Tracking:** Shows on your screen Locator Bar HUD up to **1024 blocks** away.
- **Visual Clarity:** Emits a colored waypoint marker matching the banner's color.
- **Smart Validation:** Requires 2 blocks of clear vertical space above to place in standing mode.

---

## 🎮 **Compatibility**

| Spec                        | Detail                 |
| :-------------------------- | :--------------------- |
| **Minecraft Version** | `1.21.11`            |
| **Mod Loader**        | `Fabric`             |
| **Dependencies**      | Requires`Fabric API` |

---

## 📥 **Installation**

1. Download and install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/).
2. Download and install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
3. Download the latest release of **Bannerstone**.
4. Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
5. Launch the game and enjoy!

---

## ❓ **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How do I craft a Bannerstone?**

> **A:** Arrange 7 Glowstone Dust, 1 Banner of your choice, and 1 Lodestone in a crafting table.

**Q: How do I show waypoints on my Map?**

> **A:** Right-click the placed Bannerstone with a vanilla Map. Right-click it again to remove the marker.

**Q: How do I name my waypoints?**

> **A:** Rename the Bannerstone item in an Anvil before placing it down. The custom name will automatically appear on maps.

**Q: Can I track a Bannerstone without a Map?**

> **A:** Yes! It registers automatically on your screen locator/compass bar up to 1024 blocks away.

**Q: Does it work on multiplayer servers?**

> **A:** Yes, it is fully server-compatible and synchronizes seamlessly across all clients.

**Q: Is it compatible with other mods?**

> **A:** Yes! It uses custom registry entries and standard Fabric APIs, ensuring maximum compatibility.
